heading: Fighting For Us. Always.
text: “I didn't fight radical extremists overseas just to stand by and watch left-wing extremists attack our freedoms here at home. I'm running for Congress because I believe that access to opportunity and prosperity for those willing to work for it are American ideals worth protecting. In Congress, I will fight to make America affordable again, because when groceries and gas prices are too high, Florida's families, farmers and small business owners suffer.”

heading: Meet Dan Green
text: Dan was working in the Pentagon on September 11th and experienced the devastating attack firsthand. The attack on our nation greatly impacted Dan and strengthened his resolve to serve his country. Dan joined the United States Navy, where he completed four tours throughout the Middle East and Central Asia. He also completed a civilian tour of duty to southern Afghanistan with the U.S. Department of State. Dan has earned the rank of Commander and has been selected for promotion to Captain.

heading: Meet Dan Green
text: While serving in Afghanistan and Iraq, Dan was attached to two SEAL Team deployments, including in Fallujah and southern Afghanistan; he also served in Baghdad and Kabul. His boots-on-the-ground experience has made him an expert in counterterrorism, foreign policy, and the toll of war on our brave veterans.

heading: On the Issues
text: Floridians deserve proven leaders in Washington who will stand with President Trump to safeguard our constitutional government and protect our American way of life.

heading: Follow the Constitution
text: As a member of the U.S. Navy Reserve, Dan has dedicated his life to serving our Constitution. Unfortunately, progressive members of Congress don't share his commitment. That's why Dan will work to safeguard our Constitutional rights on day one.

heading: Restoring Peace Through Strength
text: The United States is the greatest military force on earth. Our armed forces guarantee peace for the American people, protect our way of life, and secure our interests abroad. Dan will work with President Trump to ensure our military remains funded and fit for action.

heading: Stop Over-development in Florida
text: While we welcome freedom-loving Americans to our great state, overdevelopment has started to push native Floridians out of their communities. Dan is here to find real solutions to overdevelopment in Florida to protect our way of life.

heading: Lower Property Insurance Rates
text: Florida homeowners are feeling the impact of rising insurance rates. Dan Green stands with our homeowners and is ready to take their fight to Washington. Together we can make Florida affordable again.

heading: Make Groceries & Gas Affordable Again
text: We are still paying for the bad policies of the Biden Administration. Dan Green and President Trump will do everything necessary to lower fuel costs, groceries, and the ever rising cost of living.

heading: Housing Affordability
text: The American Dream of owning a home is not dead, but it is becoming more and more difficult for the next generation of homebuyers. Dan will use time-tested conservative values to lower housing costs and keep them low!
